description: Parse one PDF or image document (up to 25 MB) into clean markdown plus structured JSON with a local open-source document model (Granite-Docling). Documents never leave CoreForge infrastructure. Paid via x402 ($0.10 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

documentUrl.description: URL of the document (alternative to documentBase64)

name: document_parse
